default.q: Do you only work with real estate?
default.a: Yes. Agents, teams, brokerages, developers and property managers. Working in one industry lets us start faster and get the details right, from signage sizes to brokerage co-branding rules.

default.q: Is BeBrand a real estate brokerage?
default.a: No. BeBrand is a digital agency. We do not list, sell or manage property. We design the brand, the marketing and the website for the people who do.

One-off projects start at $1,999 and monthly plans at $699; every price is in the pricing section. Anything beyond what a package lists is quoted as a fixed price before work starts, so there are no hourly surprises.
It is two short steps online: who you are, then what you need, with your budget and timeline. We reply by email, and a kickoff call comes next.

default.q: How long does a project take?
default.a: It depends on scope. A personal brand kit is quick; a full firm identity with a website takes longer. You get a timeline in writing before we start, and we keep to it.

default.q: Can you work within my brokerage's brand rules?
default.a: Yes. Most agent brands have to sit beside a brokerage logo and follow its guidelines. We design for that from the first sketch. Send us the rules when we start.

default.q: What do I receive at the end?
default.a: All final files in print and screen formats, the editable source files, your brand guidelines, font licenses and the logins for anything we set up for you.

default.q: Can I mix services from different packages?
default.a: Yes. During onboarding you can tick any of the seven services, whichever package you start from.

default.q: I'm a new agent. Is it too early for a brand?
default.a: No. A clear personal brand helps most at the start, when you have fewer closed deals to point to. The personal brand kit is built for exactly this stage.

default.q: Do you build the website as well?
default.a: Yes. We design it, show it to you as a live prototype, then build it with listings, lead capture and a CMS you can update yourself.

default.q: Who will I be working with?
default.a: The designers you meet on the first call. Nothing is handed down to someone you have never spoken to.
